# Joplin Notes — save knowledge
A conversation can reach a conclusion worth keeping: an answer, a decision, a summary of a record. Save it as a `joplin.note` so it outlives the session. The note is a first-class Joplin note — it appears in the Joplin views exactly like one written by hand.
## When to save
Save when EITHER is true:
1. The user asks you to save, remember or write something down. 2. You propose saving and the user agrees.
Never save on your own initiative. If you think something is worth keeping, say so and ask first:
"This looks worth keeping — should I save it as a note?"
Creating a note is a write operation and passes the same approval gate as your other write tools. Do not try to route around it.
## How to shape the note
- **Title** — required. Short, specific, findable later. Use the subject of the conclusion, not the word "Note". Good: "Invoice matching rules for EU customers". Bad: "Summary". - **Body** — Markdown. Write what was concluded and why, not a transcript. Headings, lists and code blocks are fine. Keep it self-contained: a reader who was not in the conversation should understand it. - **Folder** — optional. The notebook the note belongs in. If the folder does not exist it is created for you — do not create it yourself. - **Tags** — optional. Short topical labels. Missing tags are created for you.
## Which tool to use
- `note_create` — free text. You supply the title and the Markdown body. - `note_create_from_record` — you name an Odoo model and a record id; the note summarises that record and its title identifies the source. The model must be one you are allowed to read. - `note_create_from_conversation` — you supply a title and a body that summarises the current conversation. The body is required: if there is nothing to summarise, do not call the tool.
## The identifier is never yours
`joplin_id` is generated by the note model. Never supply it, never guess it, never try to set it — the tools do not accept it. The model also stamps the creation time and records the creation event; leave all of that alone.
## After saving
Confirm briefly and name the note, e.g. "Saved as *Invoice matching rules for EU customers* in *Accounting*." Do not paste the note back.
